# SnagDaily

> Deal curation with a price-integrity focus: a real person reviews every published deal, implausible "was" prices are rejected, and prices are stamped at verification time. Current prices always governed by the retailer's site.

## Key pages
- https://snagdaily.com/: Homepage — today's verified deals
- https://snagdaily.com/today.html: Today's picks (mirrors our Instagram, refreshed all day)
- https://snagdaily.com/how-we-pick-deals.html: How deals are sourced, filtered and ranked
- https://snagdaily.com/faq.html: FAQ: affiliate links, price freshness, saved deals
- https://snagdaily.com/categories.html: Shop deals by category
- https://snagdaily.com/this-week.html: This week's best verified Walmart deals, each with its price date and live/ended status
- https://snagdaily.com/walmart-home-deals.html: Walmart Home deals — dated prices, live grid, buying guidance
- https://snagdaily.com/walmart-tools-deals.html: Walmart Tools & DIY deals — dated prices, live grid, buying guidance
- https://snagdaily.com/walmart-toys-deals.html: Walmart Toys deals — dated prices, live grid, buying guidance
- https://snagdaily.com/walmart-electronics-deals.html: Walmart Electronics deals — dated prices, live grid, buying guidance
- https://snagdaily.com/walmart-automotive-deals.html: Walmart Automotive deals — dated prices, live grid, buying guidance
- https://snagdaily.com/black-friday.html: Black Friday 2026 hub — Walmart, Amazon, Target, Best Buy dates with sources, verified Walmart deals
- https://snagdaily.com/walmart-plus.html: Is Walmart+ worth it — honest breakdown
- https://snagdaily.com/how-to-spot-a-fake-discount.html: Guide: spotting inflated reference prices
- https://snagdaily.com/best-time-to-buy.html: Guide: best time to buy, by category
- https://snagdaily.com/about.html: About / editorial standards
